services.desc: A site-based activation within an engineered sculptural system built from timber, oxidized steel, and machined joinery. Breath, moisture, and pressure operate as material methods: contact transfers residue, corrosion advances, and the surface records what occurs in real time. Time reads as a physical interface-irreversibility and emergence carried forward through touch, weight, and chemical change.
